review_level.ja: 一次資料の選択箇所、独立Thomas参照48判定、固定入力の科学判定。実際の成否はresult.jsonとverification.jsonに記録します。
review_level.en: Selected primary passages, 48 qualified independent-reference decisions and fixed-input scientific gates. Actual outcomes are recorded in result.json and verification.json.

title.en: BFGS and three-pair L-BFGS at known minima

summary.ja: 8次元SPD二次関数と3初期値のRosenbrockを用い、曲率・strong Wolfe・現在の有限記憶作用を検査します。
summary.en: An eight-dimensional SPD quadratic and three Rosenbrock starts test curvature, strong Wolfe conditions and the current finite-memory action.

assumptions.ja: 無次元の非有界代数的最適化。既知の解析最小点を持ち、物理PDEの境界条件はありません。
assumptions.en: Dimensionless unconstrained algebraic optimization with known analytic minima; there is no physical PDE boundary condition.

algorithm.ja: 独自逆BFGSとベクトルだけの2-loop L-BFGS（3組）。独立な小稠密oracleは現在γ₀Iから現在保持する組だけを古い順に再生。SciPy BFGS/L-BFGS-B（bounds=None）を別実装として比較。
algorithm.en: Original inverse-BFGS and vector-only two-loop L-BFGS with three pairs. A separate small dense oracle replays only currently retained pairs from the current gamma0 I. SciPy BFGS and unbounded L-BFGS-B are distinct software companions.

validation.ja: 16固定fit、解析的な最小点・勾配、各受理stepのstrong Wolfeと解像された正曲率、BFGSの対称SPD、L-BFGS作用差を判定。保持組とoracle稠密行列の記憶を分離。
validation.en: Sixteen fixed fits check analytic minima/gradients, strong Wolfe and resolved positive curvature at every accepted step, symmetric SPD BFGS matrices and L-BFGS action defects. Retained-pair and dense-oracle storage are reported separately.

limits.ja: 厳密線形探索ではないためn反復終了や一般的Rosenbrock大域収束を主張しません。原著選択箇所は弱Wolfeであり、本例のstrong Wolfeと区別。Fletcher1970本文は未読です。
limits.en: No exact n-step termination or general global convergence on Rosenbrock is claimed. The selected original text uses weak Wolfe, distinct from this study’s strong Wolfe policy. Fletcher’s 1970 original article remains unread.

formulas: H_+=(I-\rho s y^T)H(I-\rho y s^T)+\rho s s^T

references.title: On the limited memory BFGS method for large scale optimization
references.review_scope: Author-hosted PDF selected physical pages 3–5 (printed 2–4), rendered locally and visually inspected: limited storage, deletion of oldest correction, Eq. (2.1) inverse-BFGS, Algorithm 2.1 and Eq. (2.6) retained-update construction. No full-paper/proof/experiment or Section 4 scaling review. The selected original uses weak Wolfe; this study deliberately uses a separately specified strong-Wolfe line search. Current-gamma least-squares scaling is independently derived here, not attributed to unread text.
references.year_role: bibliographic metadata retained from prior author-source record

references.title: SciPy 1.14.1 line_search documentation
references.review_scope: Signature, c1/c2, descent-direction requirement, returned failure None and evaluation counts. Cited textbook pages were not read.

references.title: SciPy 1.14.1 BFGS documentation
references.review_scope: Options gtol, norm, c1/c2, hess_inv0 and precision-loss notes; no claim of reading a BFGS original paper.

references.title: SciPy 1.14.1 L-BFGS-B documentation
references.review_scope: Options maxcor, ftol, gtol/projected-gradient convention, maxfun, maxiter and maxls.

references.title: A new approach to variable metric algorithms
references.review_scope: Prior saved publisher metadata/abstract-search record only. Original article full text remains unavailable/unread; no new request was made and no derivation is claimed to have been checked against it.

editorial_note.en: No exact n-step termination or general global convergence on Rosenbrock is claimed. The selected original text uses weak Wolfe, distinct from this study’s strong Wolfe policy. Fletcher’s 1970 original article remains unread. Plot axes describe finite-dimensional variables, iterations or diagnostics, not a physical spatial dimension or PDE boundary.

scope.en: These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems.
